comparisons.peer_summary: The provision for income taxes increased in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, primarily due to a non-recurring intra-group transfer of IP rights to the U.S. in 2024 and higher pre-tax income in 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom attribute increases in their 2024 income tax provisions to specific structural transactions and intercompany activities rather than just operating performance. AMD cites a '$373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction' as a primary driver alongside higher pre-tax income. Similarly, Broadcom attributes its increase to a 'non-recurring intra-group transfer of certain IP rights to the United States' and the resulting shift in jurisdictional mix. Both disclosures highlight that corporate restructuring and integration activities significantly impacted their effective tax rates and provision amounts in 2024.

sentences.text: The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.

The increase in provision for income taxes in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023 was primarily due to the impact of a non-recurring intra-group transfer of certain IP rights to the United States as a result of supply chain realignment and the resulting shift in jurisdictional mix of income, partially offset by an increase in excess tax benefits from stock-based awards.
